description: Ministry of Food Security - Order to confer powers on Jayasekara Mohottiralalage Hashini Nilwala Gunawardhana Jayasekara and on 02 others who were appointed to assist the Commissioner of Co-operative Development and the Register of Co-operative Societies
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the conferment of powers under specific laws (Co-operative Societies Law and its amendments) and related rules. It deals with legal instruments, regulatory frameworks, and statutory powers granted to officials, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
